title: Mountain Pagoda Village
description: A sprawling ancient East Asian mountain village built on cliffs and rocky outcrops, featuring multi-tiered pagodas with orange-tiled roofs and wooden structures connected by stone bridges over a misty chasm with a waterfall below.
prompt: Ancient East Asian fantasy mountain village built on steep rocky cliffs, multiple ornate multi-tiered pagodas with curved orange-tiled roofs and wooden balconies, stone pathways and bridges spanning a misty gorge with cascading waterfall below, atmospheric perspective with distant peaks, detailed stonework and wooden architecture, warm morning light
